_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the annotation store. The live store is a private record at monitor/private/annotations.json (CW_ANNOTATIONS overrides; absent means nothing is annotated). Append-only log of human judgments over findings: accept / false-positive / wont-fix / note. Applied by rollup.mjs AS-OF each slice's generated time. 'expires' (optional ISO date) re-opens a judgment for review. annotations[] are dependency waivers matched on id + package + repo; name the repo, because an omitted repo matches every repo in the fleet.

annotations.reason: Synthetic example: the vulnerable entry point is never called by this service, and no fixed release existed at acceptance time.

_scannerComment: Scanner-finding annotations (scannerFindings rows). STRICT matcher: every field of the category's identity tuple (monitor/detail-schema.mjs) plus repo is required. Written by bin/annotate.mjs or the panel.

scannerAnnotations.reason: Synthetic example: a documented placeholder value in a setup guide, not a credential.
